# Swayam Prajapat — Full-Stack Developer (Full Profile & Context)

## Bio & Overview

Swayam Prajapat is a full-stack developer who handles the entire development lifecycle from pixel-perfect UI and motion design to scalable server architectures and databases. He focuses on fast load times, clean code architecture, and practical execution.

- Location: India (Working Worldwide)
